text: Quảng Trị to showcase cultural heritage, economic potential ahead of APEC 2027

QUẢNG TRỊ - Quảng Trị Province will launch a series of cultural, tourism and investment promotion activities from 2026 to capitalise on Việt Nam's hosting of APEC Year 2027 and attract greater international attention to the central Vietnamese locality.

The provincial People's Committee has instructed departments and local authorities to prepare communication campaigns and promotional programmes ahead of the event, with activities continuing throughout 2027, particularly during major APEC meetings and events.

Hoàng Nam, permanent vice chairman of the provincial People's Committee, said APEC Year 2027 would provide an important opportunity to promote Việt Nam's image and highlight the economic potential, cultural heritage and development strengths of its localities to international audiences.
He called for coordinated and practical promotional activities tailored to local conditions, stressing the need for early preparations to maximise the event's benefits.

Under the plan, provincial agencies will highlight Việt Nam's role in the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) forum, its contributions to regional cooperation and the forum's impact on trade, investment, economic growth and sustainable development.
Quảng Trị will also promote its socio-economic achievements, historical and cultural heritage, tourist destinations, local products and investment environment.

The provincial Department of Culture, Sports and Tourism will coordinate with the Department of Foreign Affairs and relevant agencies to select distinctive cultural assets, heritage sites and tourism products for promotional campaigns.
These will be featured in local cultural, artistic and tourism events linked to the APEC Year 2027 programme.
Phong Nha-Kẻ Bàng National Park, a UNESCO World Heritage site, will prepare bilingual Vietnamese-English videos, photographs and other materials to highlight its outstanding universal value.
The park's management board will also expand online promotion through its website and other digital channels.

Meanwhile, the provincial Investment, Trade and Tourism Promotion Centre will incorporate APEC-related content into business conferences, trade fairs and investment promotion events, focusing on Quảng Trị's business climate, development opportunities and competitive advantages.
Authorities are encouraging the production and distribution of bilingual multimedia materials to make information about the province more accessible to foreign investors, businesses and tourists.

The provincial administration has also stressed that promotional information must be accurate, supported by reliable sources and consistent with APEC's rules and official communication guidelines, including the use of its name, terminology, logos and visual identity.
Local media organisations and digital platforms have been asked to strengthen coverage and help prevent the spread of false or misleading information about the event.
Nam urged provincial agencies and local authorities to begin cultural and communication activities in 2026 and step up their efforts in 2027, particularly around key APEC events.
He said activities should be cost-effective and focused on showcasing the province's distinctive cultural identity.

Quảng Trị expects the preparations to help attract foreign investment, promote tourism and expand international cooperation, while creating new opportunities for local economic and social development. - VNS
